item.title: Self-Hosted MySQL High Availability: InnoDB Cluster vs Percona XtraDB Cluster vs Orchestrator (2026)
item.description: MySQL remains the world’s most popular open-source relational database, but running it in production without a high availability (HA) strategy is a recipe for downtime and data loss. Whether you’re managing an e-commerce platform, a SaaS application, or an internal tool, ensuring your MySQL database stays online through hardware failures, network partitions, and planned maintenance is non-negotiable.
